scientific_integrity: The claim is supported by the analytical Markov-boundary proof and exact computational checks. Finite enumeration is not offered as proof of infinitely many periodic-count identities. Independent validation and historical-priority audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the degree-minus-two circle map and open symmetric holes between 3/7 and 4/9.
Endpoint counts assume that 0 and 1 are identified on the circle; interval-endpoint models have different boundary counts.
Previously known entropy at the 4/9 boundary is not attributed to this result.
The full history of specialized dynamical-zeta formulas for open interval maps has not been exhaustively ruled out.
title: Golden-mean entropy without periodic-orbit bifurcation in symmetric negative-doubling holes
